Subject: ACE registration / PDM & PSM intro for HelixHealth opportunity

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking a look at this — I'm leading the ML platform at HelixHealth. We have an upcoming RFP and would like to get Redwood enrolled in the AWS ACE program so our AWS sellers can co-sell. The HS account team asked for a PDM/PSM intro and a short evidence packet to validate ACE eligibility (cost profile, customer references, SOC2 status).

Quick context: this is a potential POC for patient data summarization integrated into our clinical workflows. Target procurement window: early December (budget approval expected by Dec 10).

Can you:
- confirm Redwood's ACE registration status / next steps to enroll?
- introduce us to your PDM and PSM so we can align on a mutual action plan?

I attached a short opportunity brief. Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week if helpful.

Best,
Signe

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min handshake with PDM/PSM + your AWS seller to confirm eligibility checks.
2) We’ll provide a one-page ACE evidence summary (SOC2, customer refs, typical onboarding timeline) and our ACE intake packet.

Thanks Tessa — quick note with a recommended "dual-path" approach that compresses the intake timeline while keeping ACE formalities intact.

Dual-path (recommended):
- Path A (fast track, seller-driven): get AWS seller to register the opportunity in ACE immediately and request co-sell review. We provide a short "ACE evidence summary" (one page) and two references. Timeline: 48-72 hours to get initial eligibility confirmation from AWS.
- Path B (paperwork): we run the formal ACE enrollment checklist in parallel (account MOP, legal redlines, procurement artifacts). Timeline: up to 7 business days.

Immediate asks for HelixHealth to speed approval:
- Confirm AWS seller/reps (name + email) — we can loop them into the ACE intake.
- Procurement contact (email) so we can send required docs and a sample contract redline.
- Any existing security questionnaire output (if you’ve already completed SOC/ISO scans for other vendors).

Attachments I'm sending to Signe: ACE_checklist.xlsx, MOP_template.docx, sample_ACE_evidence.pdf (this last file is the one-page summary we referenced).

I’ll draft a 30-min agenda for the handshake call (seller intro, eligibility checklist, mutual action plan with dates).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Partner Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: ACE_checklist.xlsx; MOP_template.docx; sample_ACE_evidence.pdf
